item.unstable_frontiers.rift_shard.tip0: Use to cross into the Unstable Frontier; use there to return.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_shard.tip1: Expedition camps lie near where you arrive. Read the journals.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_shard.tip2: Lost your way? /frontier return takes you home.
item.unstable_frontiers.cage_trophy.tip0: Taken from the guardian of a cage tower or the Hanging Gaol.
item.unstable_frontiers.cage_trophy.tip1: One of the three parts of the Cagewright's Key.
item.unstable_frontiers.rookery_talon.ti: One of the three parts of the Cagewright's Key.
Forges and repairs the Cagewright's Shackle.
item.unstable_frontiers.hive_heart.tip0: Still beating. Cut from the Hive Tyrant.
item.unstable_frontiers.hive_heart.tip1: One of the three parts of the Cagewright's Key.
item.unstable_frontiers.great_cage_heart: What kept the Cagewright's Beast alive.
Builds a Cage Beacon: safe ground in the frontier,
and an anchor your Rift Shard returns you to.
item.unstable_frontiers.cagewright_key.t: Opens the lock of the Great Cage, in the Rustbone Scar.
Use it on the lodestone lock beside the south door.
What is inside wakes when the lock turns.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_lens.tip0: Use in the frontier to survey the nearest cage, lair and camp.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_lens.tip1: The Great Cage shows once you carry the Cagewright's Key.
item.unstable_frontiers.cagewright_shack: Use on a hostile creature below a third of its health.
It fights for you for 60 seconds, then crumbles. No bosses.
item.unstable_frontiers.swarmbreaker.tip: Use to Pounce: leap, and land in a shockwave that smashes egg clutches
and staggers the insects it hits. Repair with Cage Trophies.
Three plates over a netherite piece make Gnashback Carapace.
item.unstable_frontiers.shrike_talon.tip: Three talons, a netherite ingot and a stick make the Shrike Impaler.
item.unstable_frontiers.shrike_impaler.t: Double damage to anything in the air.
Drives flyers down; knocks a Shrikewing out of the sky.
item.unstable_frontiers.matriarch_mantle: Works in your hotbar or off hand.
Wingsail: long falls become a glide (sneak to drop). No fall damage.
Brood truce: wild insects leave you be until you strike them.
hint.unstable_frontiers.gnashback: A Gnashback has your scent. When it scrapes the ground, step aside: a charge into a wall or tree stuns it, and its open back takes double damage.
hint.unstable_frontiers.shrikewing: A Shrikewing is circling you. When it screeches, leave the marked spot: a missed dive leaves it climbing slowly or stranded on the ground.
hint.unstable_frontiers.chained_matriarc: The Matriarch: get behind her when the sparks show the scythe arc, keep moving under acid, strike the sac when it opens, and break the pylons to snap her chains.
message.unstable_frontiers.matriarch_fre: The chains snap! She is free, and she can leap.
message.unstable_frontiers.matriarch_bro: She opens her brood sac. Strike it now!
advancement.unstable_frontiers.mantle.de: Take the Matriarch's Mantle from the Great Cage
advancement.unstable_frontiers.gnashback: Take a plate from a Gnashback (let it charge into something hard)
advancement.unstable_frontiers.shrikewin: Take a talon from a Shrikewing
landmark.unstable_frontiers.cage_tower.s: Every cage here was full once.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.cage_tower.c: The cages are empty. The vault is open.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.hive.conquer: The resin wall behind the throne gives way.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.carrion.conq: The feeding is over, for now.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.great_cage.s: The Cagewright built this to hold one thing.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.great_cage.c: The Great Cage is broken. The vault below is open.
zone.unstable_frontiers.brood.start: Break the clutches, or they never stop hatching.
zone.unstable_frontiers.finale.start: The Matriarch wakes. Break the four pylons to snap her chains.
elite.unstable_frontiers.slam.tell: %s rears up. Get out of the ring!
message.unstable_frontiers.sealed: %s is sealed. Clear the rest first (%s).
message.unstable_frontiers.finale_locked: The Great Cage is locked. The Cagewright's Key turns it, at the lodestone by the south door.
message.unstable_frontiers.roster_missin: This fight cannot start: roster '%s' is missing from the mod's data. See latest.log for the fix.
message.unstable_frontiers.roster_unusab: This fight cannot start: roster '%s' needs creatures that are not installed: %s. Install Antarchy 2.2.9 (Integrated Boogaloo 1.0.8) or fix the roster.
message.unstable_frontiers.busy: It waits: too many fights are running on this server.
message.unstable_frontiers.brood_broken: The brood is broken. Nothing more will hatch.
message.unstable_frontiers.key_no_lock: The key fits only the lock of the Great Cage.
message.unstable_frontiers.shield_down: The last pylon falls. It can be hurt now.
message.unstable_frontiers.shielded: The pylons shield it. Break them!
message.unstable_frontiers.problems: Unstable Frontiers found %s data problems (fights that cannot start):
message.unstable_frontiers.shackle_stron: It is too strong yet. Wear it down to a third first.
message.unstable_frontiers.shackle_bound: %s is bound to you for 60 seconds.
message.unstable_frontiers.beacon_anchor: The Cage Beacon holds. Your Rift Shard will bring you here.
message.unstable_frontiers.lens_elsewher: The lens shows only the frontier.
message.unstable_frontiers.lens_clouded: Far off, something vast. The lens clouds over. (Carry the Cagewright's Key.)
message.unstable_frontiers.arrive: The Unstable Frontier. Smoke from an expedition camp, %s blocks to the %s.
message.unstable_frontiers.arrive_none: The Unstable Frontier. No camp in sight; travel and watch the skyline.
message.unstable_frontiers.no_frontier: The frontier dimension is missing (is the data pack disabled?).
message.unstable_frontiers.return_not_he: You are not in the frontier.
message.unstable_frontiers.return_cooldo: The rift is still closing. Try again in %s s.
advancement.unstable_frontiers.root.desc: Craft an Unstable Rift Shard (amethyst, crying obsidian, an eye of ender)
advancement.unstable_frontiers.survey.de: Find one of Ilsa Vane's expedition camps, or a Rift Lens
advancement.unstable_frontiers.caged.des: Enter a Gibbet Spire or the Hanging Gaol
advancement.unstable_frontiers.carrion.d: Find a Carrion Field, where the insects and the predators meet
advancement.unstable_frontiers.trophy.de: Defeat a cage's guardian and take its Cage Trophy
advancement.unstable_frontiers.talon.des: Defeat the Rookmother and take a Rookery Talon
advancement.unstable_frontiers.hive_hear: Defeat the Hive Tyrant and take its heart
advancement.unstable_frontiers.swarmbrea: Forge the Swarmbreaker from a Hive Heart
advancement.unstable_frontiers.shackle.d: Forge the Cagewright's Shackle from a Rookery Talon
advancement.unstable_frontiers.key.desc: Join a Cage Trophy, a Rookery Talon and a Hive Heart
advancement.unstable_frontiers.great_cag: Stand in the Rustbone Scar, inside the Great Cage
advancement.unstable_frontiers.cage_hear: Break the pylons and kill the Chained Matriarch
Shrikewing screeches: it is about to dive
